approved_decisions_source: User-approved Step 5 decisions (this conversation); no thresholds/weights/formula invented beyond implementing those decisions.

input_files.drivers.csv: Step 3 output, read-only (for flag_duplicate_name, flag_license_vs_age context only)

primary_features.speed_delta_mean_kmph: trip-level mean, from driver_trip_features.csv (Step 4). NOTE: user's approval referred to this feature as 'speed_delta_kmph'; driver_trip_features.csv has no column of that exact name, and this is the only Step-4 speed-delta feature available, so it is used as the intended referent. Flagged here for visibility rather than assumed silently.

excluded_features.optional_high_speed_time_pct: excluded per approval (Step 4 already excluded from primary behavioural assessment)

directionality: Higher values of all 4 primary components (more harsh accel/brake events, higher event rate, larger mean speed delta) => higher risk => lower driver_safety_score.

weighting.scheme: Equal weighting across the 4 approved components
weighting.justification: No alternative weighting scheme is defined anywhere in the approved Step 2-4 project; user's Step 5 approval explicitly specified equal weighting as the default in that case.

aggregation_method.type: Exposure-weighted (not unweighted mean of per-trip rates)
aggregation_method.accel_rate_per10min_formula: sum(harsh_accel_events * trip_weight over usable trips) / sum(trip_duration_min * trip_weight over usable trips) * 10
aggregation_method.brake_rate_per10min_formula: sum(harsh_brake_events * trip_weight over usable trips) / sum(trip_duration_min * trip_weight over usable trips) * 10
aggregation_method.harsh_event_rate_per_10min_weighted_form: weighted average of trip-level harsh_event_rate_per_10min, weights = trip_duration_min * trip_weight
aggregation_method.speed_delta_mean_kmph_weighted_formula: weighted average of trip-level speed_delta_mean_kmph, weights = trip_duration_min * trip_weight
aggregation_method.trip_weight_definition: 1.0 for a clean usable trip (any_trip_quality_flag==0); 0.5 for a quality-flagged usable trip (any_trip_quality_flag==1); 0 (fully excluded, not just down-weighted) for any trip with flag_overlap_driver==1
aggregation_method.usable_trips_definition: All of a driver's trips EXCEPT those with flag_overlap_driver==1

score_format.method: Each of the 4 components is mapped to a 0-100 sub-score via a fixed linear scale (value=0 -> 100, value>=ceiling -> 0), then averaged with equal weights. Ceilings are hard-coded constants, not recomputed from whichever drivers are present in a given run, so scores are reproducible independent of cohort composition.
score_format.risk_ceiling_derivation: Set at approximately the 99th percentile of the driver-level exposure-weighted value observed in the current 30-driver dataset, rounded up to one decimal place, then fixed as a constant for reproducibility across future runs/cohorts.

quality_flag_handling.applies_to: any_trip_quality_flag==1 trips (excluding overlap-excluded trips, which are handled separately per rule 8)
quality_flag_handling.data_confidence_pct_definition: 100 * clean_usable_trips / usable_trips, per driver. Reported separately from the safety score, not blended into it.
quality_flag_handling.flags_retained: flag_duplicate_name, flag_license_vs_age (driver-level) and all trip-level quality/overlap flags remain visible in Step 4 output; driver_safety_scores.csv reports counts derived from them (clean_usable_trips, downweighted_usable_trips, data_confidence_pct) without deleting or hiding the underlying flags.

overlap_flagged_trip_handling.rule: Excluded entirely from scoring calculation (trip_weight=0); underlying rows in driver_trip_features.csv, trips.csv, telemetry.csv untouched.

driver_master_data_flags.flag_duplicate_name: Carried through from drivers.csv unchanged; zero effect on driver_safety_score.
driver_master_data_flags.flag_license_vs_age: Carried through from drivers.csv unchanged; zero effect on driver_safety_score.

notes: No dashboard built in this step.

No new thresholds/weights invented beyond implementing the explicitly approved rules; risk ceilings and quality-flag weight are the numeric parameters required to implement approved rules 6 and 7 and are fully disclosed above.
processed/*.csv (Step 2 files) not read or modified.
